manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Find the latest public HAL東京 support confirmation PDF when the disclosure index links to an HTML subpage that embeds the PDF instead of linking directly to it.
search_queries: HAL東京 情報公開 修学支援 確認申請書
HAL東京 高等教育 修学支援 新制度 確認申請書
steps: Open the NKZ disclosure index page https://www.nkz.ac.jp/clginfo/thinfo.html.
Follow the HAL東京 subpage link th/thZ-studyspt_13.html for 高等教育の修学支援新制度確認申請書.
Inspect the subpage HTML and read the embedded PDF source ./pdf/thZ-studyspt_13.pdf.
Classify it as latest-public publication lag for FY2026 because the PDF body is 令和7年度, not the current FY2026 target form.

reusable_rules: Treat disclosure index pages that link to HTML subpages as bounded same-site navigation, not as no-candidate failures.
On the subpage, parse embed/object/iframe PDF sources and resolve them relative to the subpage URL.
Keep embedded latest-public target forms as publication-lag evidence when the body proves the previous fiscal year.
anti_patterns: Do not require a direct a[href$='.pdf'] link on the disclosure index page.
Do not accept the embedded PDF as FY2026 success when the body fiscal year is 令和7年度.
Do not infer current-year success from the stable thZ-studyspt_13 filename; the PDF body remains the fiscal-year authority.

evidence.notes: Manual/code verification on 2026-05-13 confirmed the index and subpage return HTTP 200, the subpage contains <embed src="./pdf/thZ-studyspt_13.pdf">, the PDF returns application/pdf, and the local parser reads fiscal_year=令和7年度.
